wiki.title: Rob Plunkett
wiki.extract: Robert F. Plunkett (born 1 December 1975) is an American attorney and politician from Bennington, Vermont. A graduate of Amherst College and Brooklyn Law School, he has served for several years as a deputy state's attorney for Bennington County. In 2024, he was elected to one of two at-large Vermont Senate seats that represent the Bennington district.
